meta.name: rollback
meta.description: Prepare and rehearse a recovery path for an intended release. Use when rollback is assumed, untested or previously failed; follow the environment authority for any drill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在上线前演练回滚,让发布出问题时能快速恢复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都提心吊胆,却从没真试过回滚能不能成。
copy.tagline_en: Rehearse the rollback before release so you can recover fast when it breaks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you ship releases but have never actually tested rolling back.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先读任务上下文契约与 rollback 方法，再为一次即将发布的版本准备并演练回滚/恢复路径，并如实报告缺失的能力或未运行的检查。
howto.when: 当回滚只是被假定可用、从未测试过或此前失败过时触发；任何演练都要遵循环境授权方。若由 @fde 调用，则复用其已脱敏的数据包与范围。

say.text: 为这次发布准备一份回滚方案，并在演练环境里跑一遍。
say.note: 它会先读任务上下文与回滚方法再动手。

say.text: 上次回滚失败了，帮我重新演练一次。
say.note: 沿用你已给的信息，不重复提问。

say.text: 查一下这次发布还有哪些回滚检查项没跑过。
say.note: 缺什么会如实说明，不假装已具备。

howto.what_en: Claude first reads the task context contract and rollback method, then prepares and rehearses a recovery path for an intended release, and honestly reports missing capabilities or unrun checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a rollback is assumed, untested or previously failed; any drill must follow the environment authority. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Prepare a rollback path for this release and rehearse it in the drill environment.
say_en.note: It reads the task context and method first.

say_en.text: The last rollback failed — rehearse it again for me.
say_en.note: It reuses the context you gave, no re-asking.

say_en.text: Check which rollback checks for this release haven't been run.
